quickref.status: Default primary; launched with BBR v1.4 (Nov 28, 2012) and kept through BBG; not seen in the 2026 build [Unverified]
quickref.look: Oversized pale-grey robotic glove (#77827F) worn over his right hand. Three chunky fingers and a thumb, a glowing cyan hex core on the back (#27E5E9), cyan circuit traces and cyan fingertip dots. About 0.45 H from fingertip to cuff. His other hand keeps its red glove [Observed: File:Power_Glove.jpg, File:Power_glove.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Semi-automatic. Taps fire 'small orbs of energy'; holding charges a 'larger and more destructive orb' [Game text via wiki]. A full charge shows 'a small energy ring formed around the Glove'. Orbs travel at 1,400 u/s, and a charged shot uses the whole 100-round magazine [Fan-wiki]. Orb colour and trail are [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Uncharged: 20 damage, no splash. Charged: 'explodes on impact' [Game text via wiki], 50 damage plus 60 (within 150 u) or 30 (150-300 u) splash [Fan-wiki]. What the explosion looks like is [Unverified]

quickref.status: Launched with BBR v1.4 (Nov 28, 2012) and kept through BBG. Confirmed in the 2026 closed playtest: the loadout thumbnail (Old School skin) and HUDs reading 100/100 [Observed]
quickref.look: Orange housing (#FF7700 lit, #A14F13 in shade; #B1600B on the 2012 render) with vent slots, three lime LEDs and a green core (#50AC4B, lens #66FF08). Black octagonal muzzle ring gripped by orange prongs. Held two-handed at the hip, about 0.3 H long [Observed: File:Graham_default.png; trailer g_017/g_019]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Automatic 'short-ranged constant yellow beam': 1,000 u range, 0.08 s cooldown [Fan-wiki]. On screen, pale-gold to white concentric ring arcs (#FAE8A4 to #FFFBE4) ripple from the muzzle; there are no bullets [Observed: trailer 8.0-8.25 s; fan clip 0GuhKiAnNyc]
quickref.impact_end_result: Very little damage; builds radiation [Game text via wiki]. A yellow wedge disc (#FCFE13) over the target loses wedges until a yellow trefoil on black (#FFC30B on #190C01) remains, while Geiger ticks speed up. At full radiation the target explodes (150-200 u, can hurt Graham). The trailer shows a yellow glow with sparkles, then toy-like body pieces flying out of a white-yellow blocky cloud with a white hex floor shockwave [Observed; that this is the radiation kill is Inference]

quickref.status: Shown in the BBR 1.4.3 promo (Apr 2013), then delayed. Released in BBG 2.1 (Jul 15, 2013) per its page [Fan-wiki; version Inference]. 2.6: reload 6 to 4 s, field life 10 to 7 s
quickref.look: Long boxy dark brown-black gun (#2E231C) with orange-brown bands, a ribbed top rail, a black handle on a silver post, a silver hex-nut muzzle and a grey-tan underslung canister with an orange emblem and a looping hose [Observed: File:Rosie.png, File:1.4.3Weapons_B.png, File:Rivet_Gun.jpg]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Fires 'electrified rivets' [Game text via wiki]: 4 per clip, 1 s rate, 1,600 u/s [Fan-wiki]. What the rivets look like in flight is [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Rivets stick to floors or walls and form 'light purple energy fields' that last 7 s. The fields are square from above and do 30 DPS, more toward the centre; the rivets themselves do no damage [Fan-wiki]. No image of a field [Unverified]

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.5 (Nov 27, 2013); 60 Gas. 2.6 raised projectile speed from 400 to 750 [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Short, fat orange-gold cylinder (#EA9C3E) with dark bands, a cream rim and a glowing bright-green octagonal front face (#47F542). Held at the chest, about 0.25 H long [Observed: File:Hand_Cannon.png, File:GIgramhambundle.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'This slow moving missile' [Game text via wiki]: a 'comically large green-black missile', 2 per clip, 1 s cooldown [Fan-wiki]. No image of the missile [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: 'causes a massive explosion on contact' [Game text via wiki]: 20-40 damage, AoE 100/300 u, high risk of killing himself [Fan-wiki]. What the explosion looks like is [Unverified]

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013) at 80 Gas; now 60 Gas [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Boxy dark-grey launcher (#1B1F1D) with a glowing green slot (#48E460). A big white toothed blade (#C9C9C8) stands upright at the front, blurred as if spinning; about 0.35-0.4 H across [Observed: File:BuzzSaw.jpg]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'Gun that shoots spinning saw blades' [Game text via wiki]: 3 per clip, 1 s rate. Blades dig into surfaces and weakly home on the nearest enemy, then sink into the ground or hover. One of two projectiles that pass through the Iron Curtain [Fan-wiki]
quickref.impact_end_result: 'explode on impact' [Game text via wiki]: 70 damage plus 35-70 explosive splash, the same at any distance [Fan-wiki]. What the explosion looks like is [Unverified]

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.12 (Oct 2, 2014); level 10, 60 Gas. Stats changed since its first wiki revision [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Long dark-maroon barrel (#663634) with white swooshes, a salmon-pink bulbous chamber (#BC6C5C), a yellow collar and a hanging yellow tank (#CBA41B). Reads as a pump bug-sprayer [Observed: File:Musket.jpg; bug-sprayer reading Inference]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Shotgun-like short cone, 1.5 s rate, 3 ammo; 'shoots green stuff of what appears to look like bug spray' [Fan-wiki]. No image of the spray [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Damage plus radiation within 100-150 u; uses the shared radiation disc, Geiger ticks and detonation [Fan-wiki: Status Effects]

quickref.status: Default secondary; launched with BBR v1.4 and in SkyVu's 2012 beta loadout [Observed]. Its stats conflict across the logs [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Carried: a white/light-grey box with vent slots, red stripes and a red light knob. Deployed: a white boxy gun (#8D8F87 in shade) with team-colour diagonal stripes and handle (blue #06247C or red), one barrel with a white tip, a dark Z-shaped neck and an X-shaped base with four light feet [Observed: File:Turret.jpg, File:Turretdeploy.png, File:Turret_2.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Sets up in 2-3 s, 'cannot turn', fixed 100° cone, unlimited shots every 0.25 s at one target, imperfect accuracy; one at a time; self-destructs via the reload button [Fan-wiki]. The bullets' look is [Unverified]; an early wiki claim implies Electric Honey bees [Inference]
quickref.impact_end_result: Small repeated hits. When destroyed, 'after two seconds of smoking, it will vanish'. Immune to status effects [Fan-wiki]

quickref.status: Launched with BBR v1.4; 100,000 Joules. 2.6 enlarged its AoE. The red detonate button was later moved to the reload button [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Olive-khaki four-pronged claw-star (#40442C) with dark prongs, held flat in one hand. Placed mines lie flat on floors or stick to walls, each with a glowing green centre and a thin red line sticking straight out [Observed: File:Proximity_Mine.jpg, File:So_many_mines.jpg, File:Dat_Engineer.jpg]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thrown; sticks to any surface and bounces off players; 4 ammo [Fan-wiki]. The tossed mine is the projectile; its flight look is [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes near enemies or on remote trigger (not in mid-air): 20-110 damage, AoE 140/300, can kill Graham, and enemy explosives can set it off [Fan-wiki]. SkyVu's beta thumbnail shows a white starburst with long cream rays and a yellow puff [Observed, low-res; that it is a mine blast is Inference]

quickref.status: Added in BBR 1.4.3 (store notes Apr 15, 2013; shipped as 1.4.3.1 Apr 23, 2013) through BBG; 90 Gas. 2.6: clip 1 to 3, puddle radiation 2 to 10 [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Fat tan gerbil (#DFC37E) with a brown back stripe, glowing yellow eyes, an open red mouth with buck teeth and goo, a black harness with a yellow-black hazard band, a silver-black carry handle and lime goo patches (#C2E339). Carried like a lantern, about 0.35 H [Observed: File:Gernobyl.jpg, File:Gernobil.jpg, File:1.4.3Weapons_B.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Lobs 'irradiating globs of light green goo' at 1,000 u/s that 'split into 2 to 3 droplets' [Fan-wiki]. Wiki image: small glowing yellow-green droplets (#98CB31) with tails. Trailer: a chunky faceted lime glob about head-sized, plus glowing green ovals (#5AC443) [Observed]
quickref.impact_end_result: A hit causes radiation plus slight damage; a miss leaves a 4.5 s puddle that irradiates [store note via Fan-wiki; Fan-wiki]. The puddle is a flat, opaque, lumpy lime goo (#BBE12F) [Observed: File:Radioactive_puddle.jpeg]. In the trailer the glob splashes the target, which glows yellow-green, then gets the trefoil [Observed]

quickref.status: No log names it. Most likely BBG 2.13 (Oct 31, 2014), the day the fan clip was published [Inference]. Level 15, 150,000 Joules [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Glossy magenta-purple sphere (#92219B) with a lighter swirl (#B078C1) and a white highlight, held on the palm, about 0.25 H [Observed: File:BlackHole.jpg; fan thumbnails 7gdfSoWC2ZI]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Fired or thrown orb at 1,000 u/s; 1 ammo, 2.5 s rate [Fan-wiki]. What the orb looks like in flight is [Unverified]
quickref.impact_end_result: Creates an area that slows enemies by 65% for 4 s while dealing about 30 DPS; it can hurt Graham [Fan-wiki]. The field's look is [Unverified]. A fan kill frame shows a teal glow with dark chunks [Observed, low-res; meaning Unverified]

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013) as Slow Field, 50,000 Joules; renamed later [Fan-wiki]. Its 2026 name is [Unverified]
quickref.look: Dark-brown sphere (#2E150B) netted with glowing lime-green lines (#31FA48), with purple spiky knobs (#7E1C7B) at the nodes, held in one hand, about 0.27 H [Observed: File:Slowfield.png, File:Grahamzillabundle.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Fires 'a prickly purple-green ball in an arc'; 1 ammo, 2.5 s rate [Fan-wiki]
quickref.impact_end_result: On hitting a surface (not a player) it 'forms a medium-sized force field' that slows enemies by 75% for 3 s, with no damage. Slowed players show a yellow Z [Fan-wiki]. The field's look is [Unverified]

quickref.look: Purple fuel-rod cylinder (#7B337E) with a lime chevron stripe (#7BF547), a green trefoil decal and an end cap of glowing green hex vents, held level at the waist, about 0.4 H [Observed: File:Radiation_Rod.png, File:Grahamzillabundle.png]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Placed, not fired: 5 rods, 1 s apart, 10 s duration [Fan-wiki]
quickref.impact_end_result: 'creates a glowing radiation field' that irradiates at 60/s (the fastest radiation) and blocks Sniper lock-ons. Detonation uses the shared radiation system; Graham is immune to his own radiation but not the blast [Fan-wiki]. The field's look is [Unverified]

quickref.status: Added in BBG 2.51 (Apr 13, 2018); 400,000 Joules; the wiki page is a stub [Fan-wiki]
quickref.look: Handheld red dragon head (#FD0203) with green eyes, white teeth, small horns and red wings, and a long silver double-edged blade jutting from its mouth, about 0.6 H [Observed: File:DragonSlayzer(BBG).jpeg]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Infobox only: 800 u/s projectile, 4 ammo, explosives 10-20, damage 35 [Fan-wiki]. What it fires in BBG is [Unverified]. BBO's version (a different game) fires an 'orange blast' laser [Fan-wiki]
quickref.impact_end_result: Unknown; an unnamed 4-second 'Duration' effect is listed [Fan-wiki; Unverified]

Purple crowbar (#4D4159) whose hook is a crow's head with spiky dark-purple feathers, a tan beak and a pale eye, about 0.8 H [Observed: File:Image9.PNG]

soul_corrections.current_text: Exception: the 2013 BBG trailer card shows a different look (rainbow-striped cap, black-rimmed glasses, red track jacket, orange drill-gun) [Observed] ([trailer][trailer13]), probably the "Instagraham" skin [Inference]
soul_corrections.correction: The 'orange drill-gun' is the Gamma Ray: an orange housing, a green core tube, lime LEDs and a black octagonal muzzle with orange prongs. The 'glasses' are dark-rimmed goggles with camera-lens lenses, which matches the wiki's Instagraham trivia ('stripe of colours on his helmet and camera lens on his goggles') [Fan-wiki]. The same card is reused at 10.75-11.5 s of the 2026 Steam trailer, and 7.2-10 s show that skin firing the Gernobyl, then the Gamma Ray.

soul_corrections.current_text: - **Weapons:** BBG defaults [Fan-wiki] Power Glove ("This weapon can HANDle any situation."), Turret ("Use it wisely, you only get one at a time.") and T Square ("Tee off on your opponents with this classic tool. Ouch.") [Game text via wiki]
soul_corrections.correction: List the full 17-weapon BBG arsenal with eras. Primaries: Power Glove and Gamma Ray (v1.4, Nov 2012), Rivet Gun (2.1), Hand Cannon (2.5), Buzzsaw (2.6), MuskIt (2.12). Secondaries: Turret and Proximity Mine (v1.4), Gernobyl (1.4.3), Radiation Rod (2.5), Bind Field, formerly Slow Field (2.6), Black Hole (about 2.13), Dragon Slayzer (2.51). Melees: T Square and Wrench (v1.4), Double Wrench (2.12), Crowbar (2.21). Note that only the Gamma Ray is confirmed in the 2026 build.

soul_corrections.current_text: Gernobyl, per the BBR v1.4.3 patch notes: "This mid-sized rodent shoots irradiated goop." [Game text via wiki] ([Updates][wup])
soul_corrections.correction: The quote is truncated and mislabelled. The transcribed note reads: "This mid-sized rodent shoots irradiated goop: a hit will cause radiation damage and slight physical damage, if you miss an opponent it creates a radioactive puddle- any player who steps in it will receive radiation damage." Label it [Fan-wiki transcription of SkyVu App Store notes; Unverified against the store]. Add the in-game text: "Radioactive goo never hurt anyone, unless of course it came from the contaminated mouth of an adorable little mutated mammal. The longer your exposure the greater your chance of death!" [Game text via wiki].

soul_corrections.current_text: a dark blue-grey mechanical gauntlet hand (side unrecorded; BBG News: right [BBG News invention])
soul_corrections.correction: The mechanical hand is card and concept art only. The in-game BBG model that holds every weapon has two red-gloved hands. The Power Glove weapon is a separate, oversized pale-grey robotic glove (#77827F) with a cyan hex core (#27E5E9) and cyan fingertip dots, worn over his right hand. Don't merge the prosthetic with the weapon; if the prosthetic stays, the Power Glove must visibly cover it.
soul_corrections.evidence: [Observed: File:Power_Glove.jpg, File:Power_glove.png, File:Rivet_Gun.jpg, File:Slowfield.png, File:Graham_description.jpg, File:Graham_concept_art.jpg]

soul_corrections.current_text: oversized olive-green backpack with twin exhaust pipes dominating the silhouette, tan neckerchief, dark grey work shirt, yellow-orange tool belt, bandaged forearm, dark blue-grey mechanical right hand, holding a T-square
soul_corrections.correction: This prompt pack follows the card art. Every in-game weapon render shows a boxy team-coloured radio backpack (red, or teal-blue on the blue team) with an antenna and speaker grille, red gloves, a red sash, a red-and-yellow belt and white arm stripes. The in-game T Square is a silver-grey ruler blade (#848C8C) with black ticks and a dark curved crossbar, about 0.75 H; the card's T-square has a tan blade. Pick one era per short, especially when in-game weapons appear.

soul_corrections.current_text: (1) his back cracks like a ratchet and the turret swivels with each click
soul_corrections.correction: The BBG Turret 'cannot turn' and fires in a fixed 100° cone. Either flag the swivel as a knowing [BBG News invention], or have the turret ratchet up a notch per click as it deploys ('the turret rises up').

The closed-playtest #4 Engineer chapter thumbnail (34:52 of -lAtv-j9Sms) shows Graham in the Old School skin holding the Gamma Ray on the loadout screen. Playtest #3 HUDs show an orange gun at 100/100 and 0/100 with 120/120 health. The other 16 Engineer weapons are unconfirmed for 2026.
